question.text: The following figure shows the variation of potential energy V(x) of a particle with distance x. The particle has

options.text: Two equilibrium points, one stable another unstable
Three equilibrium points, one stable two unstable
Three equilibrium points, two stable one unstabl

solution.text: \(\begin{array}{l|l} \text{Stable equation} & \text{Unstable equation} \\ \hline \rightarrow \rho \varepsilon \text { is minimum } & \rightarrow \rho^2 \varepsilon \text { is maximum } \\ \rightarrow \frac{d v}{d r}=0 & \rightarrow \frac{d v}{d r}=0 \\ \rightarrow \frac{d^2 v}{d \gamma^2} > 0 & \rightarrow \frac{d^2 v}{d r^2} < 0 \end{array}\)
